name: Topaz Video AI
tagline: Topaz Video AI is a professional video enhancement application that uses deep-learning models to upscale, deinterlace, stabilise, and increase the frame rate of video footage. It runs entirely locally on your GPU, making it a privacy-friendly choice for restoring archival footage, upscaling home videos to 4K, and preparing content for large-screen delivery. Professional video editors use it as a finishing step when source quality falls short.
